checkpoint_purpose: Freeze a reproducible engineering baseline before real clinical-accuracy evaluation begins.

required_jobs: Bounded JPEG/PDF decoder and canonical intake

clinical_accuracy_entry_requirements: Freeze the evaluated target commit/tree before scoring.
Use immutable dataset manifests with record hashes and source/license provenance.
Keep training/development/test patients separated; no patient leakage.
Define label mapping and exclusion rules before looking at final test results.
Distinguish waveform measurement accuracy, rhythm/classification accuracy, image digitization accuracy, and report/interpretation accuracy.
Use adjudicated or established reference labels appropriate to each task; do not treat donor labels or synthetic fixtures as project gold.
Predefine metrics, confidence intervals, subgroup analyses, and abstention handling.
Record every failure/abstention; do not silently drop unreadable or unsupported cases.
Evaluation outputs remain nonruntime and nonreportable until evidence-admission governance explicitly changes.

priority: signal-domain interval/rhythm accuracy on immutable reference ECGs
image digitization error against paired digital waveform ground truth
lead identity and calibration correctness on real ECG images
end-to-end interpretation agreement only after the earlier layers are quantified

authority_note: This checkpoint records engineering readiness for validation. It is not evidence of clinical accuracy, safety, efficacy, or diagnostic validity.
